name: Goblet squat
cues: Hold one dumbbell at your chest, elbows tucked
Sit down between your heels, chest tall
Drive through the whole foot to stand

name: Dumbbell sumo squat
cues: Wide stance, toes turned out
Let the dumbbell hang straight down
Knees track over toes as you sit down

name: Barbell back squat
cues: Bar on your upper back, brace your middle
Sit down and slightly back, knees over toes
Stand up hard, keep your chest up

name: Leg press
cues: Feet hip-width in the middle of the platform
Lower until hips start to tuck, then stop
Press through your heels, don’t lock the knees hard

name: Tempo bodyweight squat
cues: Take 3 seconds to lower
Arms forward for balance, chest tall
Stand up quickly through the whole foot

name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
cues: Soft knees, push your hips back
Dumbbells slide down your thighs, back flat
Squeeze your glutes to stand tall

name: Single-leg Romanian deadlift
cues: Dumbbell in the hand opposite the standing leg
Hinge until your body is close to level
Keep your hips square to the floor

name: Barbell Romanian deadlift
cues: Bar close to your legs the whole time
Hips back until you feel your hamstrings
Stand tall without leaning back

name: Back extension
cues: Pad just below your hip bones
Round down slowly, then lift with your glutes
Stop when your body is in a straight line

name: Single-leg hip hinge
cues: Fingertips on a wall for balance if needed
Reach your back leg long as you hinge
Drive the standing hip forward to stand

name: Bulgarian split squat
cues: Back foot on a couch, front foot well forward
Drop your back knee straight down
Push through the front heel

name: Reverse lunge
cues: Step back long, both knees bend to 90°
Torso tall, dumbbells by your sides
Push through the front foot to return

name: Dumbbell Bulgarian split squat
cues: Back foot on a bench
Lower straight down, front knee over toes
Stand up through the front heel

name: Dumbbell walking lunge
cues: Long steps, back knee nearly touches
Stay tall, dumbbells at your sides
Push off the front foot into the next step

name: Split squat
cues: Staggered stance, feet hip-width
Lower your back knee toward the floor
Keep most of your weight on the front foot

name: Bodyweight reverse lunge
cues: Step back and lower with control
Chest tall, hands on hips
Drive back up through the front heel

name: Hip thrust
cues: Upper back on a couch, dumbbell on your hips
Chin tucked, ribs down
Squeeze at the top for a second

name: Barbell hip thrust
cues: Upper back on a bench, pad on the bar
Feet flat, shins vertical at the top
Lock out with your glutes, not your back

name: Single-leg glute bridge
cues: Lie on your back, one foot planted
Press through the heel to lift your hips
Keep your hips level

name: Floor press
cues: Lie on the floor, dumbbells over your chest
Lower until your upper arms touch the floor
Press up and slightly together

name: Dumbbell floor fly
cues: Slight bend in the elbows the whole time
Open your arms until they touch the floor
Hug a big tree to bring them back up

name: Dumbbell bench press
cues: Shoulder blades pulled back into the bench
Lower to the sides of your chest
Press up without bouncing

name: Incline dumbbell press
cues: Bench at a low incline
Lower slowly to upper chest
Press up and in

name: Cable fly
cues: Step forward, slight forward lean
Soft elbows, sweep hands together
Control the stretch on the way back

name: Push-ups
cues: Hands under shoulders, body in one line
Lower your chest between your hands
Push the floor away
note: Hands on a counter if needed

name: Incline push-up
cues: Hands on a sturdy counter or table
Body straight from head to heels
Touch your chest to the edge, press back

name: Overhead press
cues: Dumbbells at shoulder height, palms in or forward
Squeeze glutes so you don’t lean back
Press straight up, biceps by your ears

name: Seated dumbbell shoulder press
cues: Bench upright, back supported
Lower to about chin height
Press up without arching your back

name: Pike push-up
cues: Hips high, body in an upside-down V
Lower the top of your head toward the floor
Press back up through your hands

name: One-arm row
cues: Hand and knee on a couch, back flat
Pull the dumbbell to your hip pocket
Lower all the way down slowly

name: Seated cable row
cues: Sit tall, slight bend in the knees
Pull the handle to your lower ribs
Let your shoulders reach forward on the way back

name: Inverted table row
cues: Lie under a sturdy table, grip the edge
Body straight, pull your chest up
Lower with control
note: Bend your knees to make it easier

name: Dumbbell pullover
cues: Lie on the floor, one dumbbell held over your chest
Lower it behind your head with soft elbows
Pull it back over your chest with your lats

name: Lat pulldown
cues: Grip a little wider than shoulders
Pull the bar to your upper chest
Elbows drive down toward your pockets

name: Prone floor pulldown
cues: Lie face down, arms overhead
Pull elbows down to your sides, squeezing
Reach long again slowly

name: Lateral raise
cues: Light dumbbells, slight bend in the elbows
Raise out to the sides to shoulder height
Lower slowly, no swinging

name: Cable lateral raise
cues: Cable at the lowest setting, across your body
Lead with the elbow, stop at shoulder height
Control it down

name: Prone Y raise
cues: Lie face down, arms in a Y, thumbs up
Lift your arms a few inches off the floor
Pause, then lower slowly

name: Rear-delt fly
cues: Hinge forward, back flat, light dumbbells
Sweep your arms out wide
Squeeze between your shoulder blades

name: Face pull
cues: Rope at eye height
Pull toward your forehead, elbows high
Finish with hands by your ears

name: Prone T raise
cues: Lie face down, arms out in a T
Lift your arms, squeeze your shoulder blades
Lower slowly

name: Dumbbell curl
cues: Elbows pinned by your sides
Curl up, palms facing up
Lower all the way, slowly

name: Cable curl
cues: Stand tall, elbows still
Curl the bar to your shoulders
Control the way down

name: Towel curl
cues: Loop a towel under one foot, hold both ends
Curl up while your foot pushes down
Make each rep hard for the full range

name: Overhead triceps extension
cues: One dumbbell held overhead with both hands
Lower it behind your head, elbows forward
Straighten your arms fully

name: Triceps pushdown
cues: Elbows pinned by your sides
Push the bar down until arms are straight
Let it rise to just above 90°

name: Bench dip
cues: Hands on a sturdy chair behind you
Bend your elbows straight back
Press up to straight arms

name: Dead bug
cues: Lie on your back, arms up, knees over hips
Lower the opposite arm and leg slowly
Keep your low back pressed to the floor

name: Plank
cues: Forearms under shoulders
Squeeze glutes, ribs down
Breathe slowly

name: Kneeling ab rollout
cues: Kneel with the wheel under your shoulders
Roll out only as far as your back stays flat
Pull back with your abs

name: Dumbbell dead bug
cues: Hold one light dumbbell over your chest
Lower opposite leg and the weight back slowly
Low back stays on the floor

name: Side plank
cues: Elbow under your shoulder
Hips high, body in one line
Breathe and hold

name: Bird dog
cues: Hands under shoulders, knees under hips
Reach the opposite arm and leg long
Pause without rocking your hips

name: Suitcase carry
cues: One heavy dumbbell in one hand
Walk tall without leaning
Switch hands halfway

name: Pallof press
cues: Stand side-on to the cable
Press straight out from your chest
Don’t let it twist you

name: Dumbbell calf raise
cues: Balls of your feet on a step
Lower your heels slowly
Rise up as high as you can

name: Standing calf raise
cues: Shoulders under the pads
Full stretch at the bottom
Pause at the top

name: Single-leg calf raise
cues: Hold a wall for balance
Lower your heel below the step
Rise as high as you can

name: Frog pump
cues: Soles of your feet together, knees out
Drive your hips up
Squeeze hard at the top

name: Dumbbell glute bridge
cues: Lie on your back, dumbbell on your hips
Press through your heels
Squeeze at the top for a second
